skill_name: Describe how customer feedback helps improve customer experience
workflow: customer feedback helps improve customer experience by providing valuable insight into what customers love and dislike about a product or service. This information can be used to make changes or adjustments to the customer’s experience, leading to improved satisfaction, loyalty, and retention. By using customer feedback to create actionable items, businesses are better equipped to keep and attract customers, increasing their customer base and profits.
